title: Evaluating Semantic Insensitivity in Financial Sentiment Analysis: Implications for Sustainable Financial Decision-Making
abstract: arXiv:2611.21653v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Financial sentiment analysis is critical for automated trading, portfolio management, and risk assessment, heavily relying on models like FinBERT. Despite high benchmark accuracy, these models remain vulnerable to subtle adversarial text modifications, threatening the integrity of algorithmic decision-making. In this paper, we propose Agent-driven Semantic Inversion (ASI), a novel adversarial attack framework targeting financial sentiment models through domain-specific semantic manipulation. Utilizing an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline, our approach identifies eligible financial news sentences and applies targeted lexical substitutions. We empirically evaluate ASI against FinBERT, one of the most widely deployed financial sentiment models. translated_title: 评估金融情感分析中的语义不敏感性：对可持续金融决策的启示
translated_abstract: 金融情感分析对于自动化交易、投资组合管理和风险评估至关重要，其严重依赖于FinBERT等模型。尽管这些模型在基准测试中准确率很高，但它们仍然容易受到细微的对抗性文本修改的影响，从而威胁算法决策的完整性。在本文中，我们提出了智能体驱动的语义反转（Agent-driven Semantic Inversion, ASI），这是一种针对金融情感模型的新型对抗攻击框架，通过特定领域的语义操纵实施攻击。我们的方法利用由大语言模型驱动的多智能体流水线，识别符合条件的金融新闻句子并进行有针对性的词汇替换。我们对ASI进行了实证评估，目标是最广泛部署的金融情感模型之一FinBERT。结果揭示了一个惊人的脆弱性：在符合条件的案例中，攻击成功欺骗了FinBERT达90.85%，模型在文本被修改后仍频繁保持其原有的情感预测。
tldr: 本文提出了智能体驱动的语义反转（ASI）对抗攻击框架，利用LLM多智能体流水线对金融新闻进行针对性词汇替换，以90.85%的成功率欺骗了FinBERT模型，揭示了金融情感分析模型对语义操纵的严重脆弱性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes Agent-driven Semantic Inversion (ASI), a novel adversarial attack framework using an LLM-powered multi-agent pipeline that achieves a 90.85% success rate in deceiving FinBERT through targeted lexical substitutions in financial news, exposing critical semantic-insensitivity vulnerabilities in financial sentiment analysis models.
